text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0900 CDT, according to analysts.

CANOLA - C$0.50 higher following recent strength in CBOT soybean oil. Forecasts for a higher CBOT soybean opening also supportive although there is some concern that bearish soymeal stock data issued by the U.S. Census Bureau will weigh on oilseed markets. July WCE futures crush profit margin rose to -9.22 Wednesday from -10.67 Tuesday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3911 versus the U.S. dollar and also rose against the yen to 90.59.
FLAX - C$0.30 to C$0.80 up with commercial demand seen underpinning the market while producer offerings remain light.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.20 to C$0.70 down on U.S. corn calls. Commission house based support at C$140.00 on May should limit the scope of early losses.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.30 to C$0.80 lower on CBOT grain calls. Commission house support seen at $173.00 on May but commercial seen selling if market were to edge up to $174.00.
PEAS - steady underpinned by commercial demand in May, July and October contracts.
OATS - Steady to US$0.50 down on commercial offerings.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
